topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture, recaps prior material, and outlines the learning objectives and framework for the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth signaling autonomy and pathway deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic mutations within cell surface receptor pathways and downstream cascades drive autonomous proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation block in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how blocks to terminal differentiation contribute to tumorigenesis in both haematological malignancies and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis and replicative immortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how tumour cells circumvent intrinsic death and senescence barriers through disruptions in apoptosis regulation and telomere maintenance.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce complex cancer hallmarks and explore the mechanisms, functional significance, and epigenetic impacts of metabolic rewiring.

topics.label: Tumour angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the necessity of new blood vessel recruitment for tumour growth, the timing of its onset, and the balance of regulatory signals controlling it.

topics.label: Metastatic dissemination and colonization
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the multi-step cascade of cancer metastasis, the mechanisms governing distant colonization, and the genetic and mechanical factors involved.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a synthesis of how cancer hallmarks integrate during progression and closing administrative remarks.
